title: Internal Mechanisms and Assembly Interfaces
description: Use manual-based CAD teaching studies to explain hydraulic tappet internals and an IO-520 permold oil pump. Dimensions and operating travel are illustrative.

lessons.title: Inside the hydraulic tappet
lessons.objective: Identify the manual-listed internal parts and explain the role of trapped oil and replenishment.

steps.title: Assembled tappet
steps.prompt: Inspect the body and oil inlet. Open Explore to section the model and play the illustrative motion.
steps.note: Manual relationships; illustrative dimensions and operating travel. Use Explore for motion, section and isolation controls.

steps.title: Plunger and socket
steps.prompt: Rotate the exploded pose. Identify the socket, hollow plunger and return spring. Explain how these connect to the pushrod.
steps.note: Manual relationships; illustrative dimensions and operating travel. Use Explore for motion, section and isolation controls.

steps.title: Check-valve parts
steps.prompt: Find the check-valve housing, plate and spring. Explain why the valve traps oil under load and permits replenishment.
steps.note: Manual relationships; illustrative dimensions and operating travel. Use Explore for motion, section and isolation controls.

steps.title: Reassembly relationships
steps.prompt: Follow the internal stack toward its assembled position. This view shows relationships, not a maintenance procedure.
steps.note: Manual relationships; illustrative dimensions and operating travel. Use Explore for motion, section and isolation controls.

lessons.title: Inside the oil pump and relief valve
lessons.objective: Explain external-gear pumping and identify the spring-loaded relief mechanism.

steps.title: The gear pair
steps.prompt: Open Explore, isolate the gears and play. Observe their opposite directions; oil is carried around the outside, not through the meshing region.
steps.note: Manual relationships; illustrative dimensions and operating travel. Use Explore for motion, section and isolation controls.

steps.note: Manual relationships; illustrative dimensions and operating travel. Use Explore for motion, section and isolation controls.

steps.title: Relief mechanism

steps.note: Manual relationships; illustrative dimensions and operating travel. Use Explore for motion, section and isolation controls.

checks.question: Match each hydraulic tappet part to its job.
checks.hint: Use the exploded pose from the lesson.

pairs.right: Receives the end of the pushrod
Pushes the plunger outward to take up clearance
Closes to trap oil under load and opens to let oil refill
Holds the plunger and socket inside the body

checks.rationale: The socket seats the pushrod, the spring keeps the plunger extended so the clearance is taken up, the check plate controls the oil, and the ring keeps the assembly in the body.

checks.question: Why does the check valve close while the tappet is carrying load?
checks.hint: Think about what holds the plunger up when the pushrod pushes down on it.
answers: It traps the oil, so the oil carries the load to the pushrod
It lets the oil escape so the plunger can sink
It pumps oil up to the rocker arm
checks.rationale: A liquid is very hard to compress. With the check plate closed the oil under the plunger cannot escape, so it passes the load on.

checks.question: When the load comes off and the plunger extends, what happens at the check plate?
checks.hint: Oil that leaked out of the reservoir has to come back in.
answers: It opens so oil can refill the reservoir
It stays closed to hold the plunger in
It turns the pushrod
checks.rationale: In the illustrated cycle the plunger extends and the check plate opens for replenishment, so the reservoir is full again for the next load.

checks.question: What can you take from this model of the tappet?
checks.hint: Read the note on each step.
answers: How the parts are arranged; the travel and dimensions are illustrative
The oil pressure the tappet must hold
The steps for taking a tappet apart
checks.rationale: The study shows manual-based relationships only. It is not a pressure simulation or a maintenance procedure; limits and procedures come from the manufacturer’s manual.

checks.question: How do the two gears of this pump turn?
checks.hint: Play the motion with the gears isolated.
answers: In opposite directions
In the same direction at the same speed
Only one turns; the other stays fixed
checks.rationale: Two meshing external gears always turn opposite ways, which is how the teeth carry oil from the inlet side to the outlet side.

checks.question: Where does an external-gear pump carry the oil?
checks.hint: The oil is not squeezed through the point where the teeth mesh.
answers: Around the outside of the gear pair, in the spaces between the teeth and the housing
Straight through the meshing region between the two gears
Along the inside of each gear shaft
checks.rationale: Oil is trapped between the teeth and the housing wall and carried around the outside to the outlet. The meshing teeth seal the middle so oil cannot flow back.

checks.question: Match each relief-valve part to its job.

pairs.right: Lifts off its seat to open a path for the oil
Holds the plunger on its seat until pressure is high enough
Changes how far the spring is compressed

checks.rationale: The spring holds the plunger shut, the plunger lifts when pressure overcomes the spring, and the plug is where the spring compression is adjusted.

checks.question: How can opening a relief path limit the oil pressure?
checks.hint: Think about what the oil does once the plunger has lifted.
answers: Oil escapes through the opened path, so the pressure stops rising
It speeds the gears up so more oil reaches the engine
It closes the inlet so the pump stops pumping
checks.rationale: When the pressure is high enough to overcome the spring, the plunger lifts and oil passes through the opened path instead of building more pressure.

checks.question: What does the relief-valve opening animation show?
checks.hint: Read the note on the last step.
answers: The plunger moving off its seat; the travel is illustrative and no pressure is calculated
The pressure at which a real relief valve opens
The correct adjusting-plug setting for the engine
checks.rationale: The model shows how the mechanism works. It does not calculate pressure or give a setting; those values come from the manufacturer’s manual.
